items.title: Star Cross Arabesque DXF Lattice for Intricate Mashrabiya Screens
items.description: Interlocking star crosses and octagons weave into a dense arabesque lattice with fine layered outlines. The intricate, traditional geometry suits mashrabiya-style screens, mosque gates, and richly detailed room dividers.

items.title: Vintage Baroque Ornamental Frame Vector File for CNC Cutting
items.description: Expand your digital catalog with this exquisite vintage Baroque frame design, featuring elegant symmetrical scrollwork and classical filigree accents. Available for instant download in fully scalable DXF, SVG, and DWG formats, this highly decorative pattern is perfect for crafting luxury mirror frames, custom wall art centerpieces, and ornamental signage. Fully optimized for flawless execution on CNC wood routers, laser engraving machines, and plasma cutters.
